title: The Silk Roads — Peter Frankopan
body: A genuinely different lens on world history, centered on Central Asia and the connective tissue between civilizations. The kind of book that makes you feel like you've been reading everything in the wrong order.

title: Nick Drake, Five Leaves Left
body: I come back to this record every year. The fingerpicking is impossibly delicate. Trying to steal some ideas for my own playing, mostly failing, entirely fine with it.

title: What I actually believe about carbon markets
body: A month of reading arguments from every direction has left me with a complicated answer. The case for them is real. So is the case against. Trying to figure out where I land.
